sections.sectionKey: Return to major tonic and cadential arrival

1_divergence.basis: C1 first-attempt intention objects (free choices), independent of compilation

4_judgmentMap.basis: C1 first attempts; legality is C1 first-pass acceptance

failureModes.note: FM1/FM3 have no accepted C1 open-arc trial; the proposal-level destinations are reported as a diagnostic

rule.OUTCOME_1_INTENTION_PROPOSER: divergence >= 0.25 AND (first-pass + retry-2 legality) >= 0.90 AND FM4 == 0 AND ear Q9 win-or-distinct-tie
rule.OUTCOME_2_GUEST_CURATOR_MENU_BOUND: free legality < 0.90 OR FM1-FM3 present, but C2 menu yields ear-preferred divergences on arc/proportion classes
rule.OUTCOME_3_EXPLAINER_ANNOTATOR_ONLY: divergence < 0.10 OR blind A/B loss to planner control
rule.conditionalRule: If the ear gate is unsigned, no OUTCOME_1 selection is final; emit CONDITIONAL_PENDING_EAR with the deterministic criterion result.
